crossrefs.text: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
Give ear, O my people, to my instruction; listen to the words of my mouth.
I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the beginning,
Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise— apply your mind to my knowledge—
The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.
Lowborn men are but a vapor; the exalted are but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
Have I not written for you thirty sayings about counsel and knowledge,
to show you true and reliable words, that you may soundly answer those who sent you?
What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
He will be a snake by the road, a viper in the path that bites the horseʼs heels so that its rider tumbles backward.
So do not let my blood fall to the ground far from the presence of the LORD. For the king of Israel has come out to look for a flea, like one who hunts a partridge in the mountains.”
Haman recounted to them his glorious wealth, his many sons, and all the ways the king had honored and promoted him over the other officials and servants.
If I have put my trust in gold or called pure gold my security, if I have rejoiced in my great wealth because my hand had gained so much,
You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
And Cain had relations with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to Enoch. Then Cain built a city and named it after his son Enoch.
For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
I said to myself, “As for the sons of men, God tests them so that they may see for themselves that they are but beasts.”
Who knows if the spirit of man rises upward and the spirit of the animal descends into the earth?
A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish.
Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
For we brought nothing into the world, so we cannot carry anything out of it.

Then I will say to myself, “You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take it easy. Eat, drink, and be merry!”’
You, however, will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a ripe old age.
Now Jacob heard that Labanʼs sons were saying, “Jacob has taken away all that belonged to our father and built all this wealth at our fatherʼs expense.”
